name: BigCommerce
description: BigCommerce is an ecommerce platform ("Commerce built for momentum") supporting both B2C and B2B storefronts, marketplaces, and social commerce channels.
best_for: Serves a range from emerging/SMB brands (via free trial, emerging-brand programs) to enterprise merchants needing B2B features like account-specific pricing and approval workflows.
features: Drag-and-drop store builder with code-level customization

alternatives.name: Shopify
alternatives.description: An all-in-one hosted commerce platform spanning web, mobile, and POS.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants wanting a fast, managed setup from solo founders to enterprises.

alternatives.name: Ecwid
alternatives.description: An ecommerce platform that lets merchants launch a store with no transaction fees and embed selling widgets into existing sites.
alternatives.best_for: Sellers wanting to add a store to an existing website rather than rebuild it.

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: $29/month billed annually ($39 monthly); up to $30K trailing-12-month GMV, then auto-upgrades to Growth. Open Payment Provider fee can apply.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: $79/month billed annually ($105 monthly); up to $100K TTM GMV.

tiers.name: Scale
tiers.notes: $299/month billed annually ($399 monthly); $33,333/month GMV base threshold with 0.9% overage above the cap.

tiers.name: Performance
tiers.notes: Custom pricing starting at $1,499/month billed annually.
